firmware.observed_from: Operator-reported Glide/portamento release; device version screen not recorded.

capture.transport: USB CoreMIDI receive source plus bounded standard-MIDI sender
capture.topology: Host destination 0 -> FM1 and FM1 source -> host; no SysEx

exact_steps: Operator cleared Pattern 1 with stock K4 and armed REC.
Host sent ascending notes 60 through 74; each was 90 3N 5A followed 80 ms later by 80 3N 00, with the next Note On 100 ms after the preceding Note On.
Operator exited REC and started playback.
human_action.expected_result_before_observation: all 15 notes appear once before the loop repeats

traffic.to_fm1: For N = 3C through 4A inclusive: 90 N 5A at t+0,100,...,1400 ms and 80 N 00 at t+80,180,...,1480 ms. All are known standard MIDI.
traffic.from_fm1: Exact received packets are in the accompanying NDJSON; all are candidate_sequencer_related standard MIDI during playback.

observations.resulting_sequencer_behaviour: C4 through A4 each appeared exactly once at about 166 ms Note On intervals, then C4 recurred after 2,499 ms. Gates were 81-84 ms at visible Gate 50%.

comparison.differential_result: 15 notes are retained and loop; the immediately preceding 16-note input replayed only its last 15 notes. Strong evidence for a V15 15-step capacity, pending repeat of the overflow capture with a complete artifact.

notes: The sender accepts only bounded standard Note On/Off sequences; no SysEx/vendor path exists.
This is V15-specific observable behaviour and must not be mapped onto the V13 32-byte hypothesis.
